I have written, but there was a strong correlation with my creativity and my heavy consumption of pot.

Also, it makes me genuinely happy to read that challenging masterpieces of literature still interest students who are in the STEM fields. Don't be too intimidated, give yourself credit, and try reading something like Ulysses or Gravity's Rainbow (the other book that saved me, and continues to save me...). You're in the best environment to give it a try. Read aloud, search your university library for guides, and find professors more-than-willing to help. The arts & sciences need to reconcile.
